deadline.value: Physics (EPSRC and University/School-funded places): aim to apply by Jan 4 (year inferred as 2027), as interviews run January to March; later applications are considered while funding remains. Astronomy (STFC and University/School places): by Jan 23. Bell Burnell and China Scholarship Council: by Jan 4.
deadline.quote: Applications for EPSRC and University/School-funded positions in physics will be considered as they arrive until positions are filled. However, you should aim to submit your application by 4 January, as interviews are held from January to March. | Applications for STFC and University/School-funded positions in astronomy should be made by 23 January, as interviews are held in February. | China Scholarship Council applications must also be submitted by 4 January

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact prospective supervisors and indicate the supervisor of the chosen project on the application
supervisor.quote: We encourage applicants to view the list of potential projects linked below, and to contact prospective supervisors. | When making your application you can copy the project description from the available projects list into your application form and indicate the appropriate supervisor from the list.

funding.value: Fully funded scholarships (EPSRC, STFC, University and others) exist in all areas, but research councils allow only 30% of their places to go to international applicants; the School funds 1-2 donor/internal scholarships a year and may top up fees for externally awarded scholarships.
funding.quote: The research councils permit 30% of these positions to be awarded to international applicants, with the remainder restricted to UK residents. | The School awards 1-2 scholarships every year funded by donors and internal funds, and may also be able to cover the difference between home and international fees for externally awarded scholarships.

entry_route.value: Normally a 2:1 honours first degree (or overseas equivalent) in physics, astronomy or a related subject. The India page says postgraduate applicants generally need a bachelor's of at least three years with 60-80% or 7.0-9.0 CGPA, depending on the institution.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants will normally hold a first degree with Honours at 2.1 (UK) or the overseas equivalent in physics, astronomy or a related subject.

also.quote: Postgraduate candidates will be expected to hold a bachelor's degree (BA, BSc, BCom or BTech) awarded after a minimum of three years, with grades ranging from 60% to 80% or 7.0-9.0 CGPA, depending on the institution attended.

toefl_min.value: Physics PGR uses English profile 7-D. TOEFL iBT (pre-2026): 81 overall (R16, W19, L16, S19); TOEFL iBT (2026 onwards): 4.5 overall with 4.0 in each skill. IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in each component.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (pre-2026) 81 16 19 16 19 | TOEFL iBT (2026 onwards) 4.5 4.0 4.0 4.0 4.0 | IELTS Academic (including IELTS One Skill retake) 6.5 6.0 6.0 6.0 6.0

also.quote: Physics and astronomy Profile 7-D | The minimum requirements for any postgraduate research student are detailed in Profile 7-D.

english_waiver.value: India is on the list where an English-taught degree from a nationally accredited English-medium university counts only with verified medium-of-instruction evidence plus an ECCTIS QLS result confirming CEFR C1. The University may still ask for a test.
english_waiver.quote: If you have completed a qualification equivalent to a UK undergraduate or postgraduate degree taught entirely in English at a nationally accredited English-medium university (with provision of verified evidence by the awarding institution that you were taught in the medium of English) in one of the following countries or territories, you will need to provide a verified ECCTIS Qualification Language Service (QLS) English Proficiency and Qualification Comparison Unique Person Identifier (UPI) number and download of your ECCTIS QLS result, confirming the level of English language required for this qualification is equivalent to CEFR Level C1 | Ghana India Kenya

notes: Two references must arrive before an application is considered. The University says many scholarships close between December and February and require a University offer, so apply early.
